semantic.justification: Task202610111735-R760SH restores the original SwFrameAreaDefinition owner composed by every real SwFrame, replacing misplaced validity fields with native-owned zero-default absolute/relative SwRects, guarded flags and uint32 frame IDs. Point/Size template bases own by-value integer storage; SwRect retains inclusive integer edge access, signed center division, height-before-width SSize, and WRITER-006 zero-area containment. Nested write-access values write back on explicit Dispose in finally without replacing borrowed members or changing validity. Composition represents C++ multiple inheritance while preserving original SwClient registration identity. Actual root/text/table/row/cell owners and independent scope values are checked without executing upstream. Numeric support is limited to finite integers in the JavaScript exact range; full native tools/SwRect operators, transforms, invalidation consumers, geometry formatting/query integration and browser measured geometry remain unported. No broad semantic/default/whole-capability promotion; registered recovery/open/save deviations retained.
